name: smartscout-adapter
description: MCP server for SmartScout Amazon market intelligence tools.
long_description: SmartScout Adapter exposes SmartScout Amazon market intelligence data as MCP tools for brand, product, seller, subcategory, search term, relevance, and sales estimate workflows.

tools.name: smartscout_get_brand_market_share
tools.description: Get a brand's SmartScout subcategory market-share footprint.

tools.name: smartscout_get_brand_sellers
tools.description: Get seller coverage for a SmartScout brand.

tools.name: smartscout_get_product_history
tools.description: Get SmartScout product history for an ASIN.

tools.name: smartscout_get_seller_brands
tools.description: Get brands carried by a SmartScout seller.

tools.name: smartscout_get_subcategory_brands
tools.description: Get brands in a SmartScout subcategory.

tools.name: smartscout_get_relevant_products
tools.description: Get SmartScout products relevant to an ASIN.

tools.name: smartscout_get_relevant_search_terms
tools.description: Get SmartScout search terms relevant to an ASIN.

tools.name: smartscout_estimate_sales
tools.description: Estimate monthly sales velocity from category node and sales rank.
